 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to R.C.T.No.1807/2018 pending in Court of Judicial Magistrate First Class Khandwa District-Khandwa (MP) for the offence under Sections 420, 467,
468, 474, 471, 294 & 506 of IPC.

sentences.text: Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that no offence under 420, 467, 468, 471 of IPC is made out against applicant.
It is further submitted that there is no allegation under Section 419 of IPC against applicant.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the complainant opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that applicant is using forged ID cards and also committing offence.
In these circumstances, prayer is made for dismissal of bail application.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5. Complainant has not been cheated by applicant.
No offence of cheating and offence under Section 467, 468 of IPC is made out against applicant.
No allegation is made regarding Section 419 of IPC.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs.Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.
7.
The applicant shall also abide by the following conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.
